english: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco. My name is Catherine and today we have a lesson for you all about life at home and life with your parents.
chinese: 大家好，欢迎来到英语pod。我叫马可，我是凯瑟琳，今天我们为大家带来一个关于居家生活和与父母相处的课程。

english: That's right. We've all lived with our parents when we were younger or maybe we still do. And of course they have certain rules in the house and well when you break those rules something happens. There are consequences and that's what's happening in today's dialogue.
chinese: 没错，我们都曾年轻时住在父母家里，或许现在还在。当然，家里也有一定的规矩，一旦违反这些规矩就会发生一些事情。有后果，这就是今天对话中的情况。

english: So let's take a listen to this dialogue and when we come back we'll be talking more about what's going on and what some of these words and phrases mean.
chinese: 所以让我们先听听这段对话，回来后再聊一聊具体情况以及这些词和短语的意思。

english: Do you know what time it is?
chinese: 你知道现在是什么时间吗？

english: Um, ten.
chinese: 哦，十。

english: Get in this door young man. It's midnight. You are two hours past curfew.
chinese: 进来吧小伙子，现在已经半夜了，你已经超过了就寝时间两个小时。

english: I know, but it wasn't my fault. I told Jennifer she had to drop me off before ten, but she wouldn't leave the party.
chinese: 我知道，但那不是我的错。我告诉詹妮弗十点前必须送我去，但她却不愿离开派对。

english: I don't care. You are grounded for life, mister.
chinese: 我不care。先生，你一世都得被禁足。

english: Mom, that is so unfair.
chinese: 妈妈，这太不公平了。

english: You know the rules and you broke them. No allowance and no TV for a week. I usually never ground you, but this time I have to put my foot down.
chinese: 你知道规则，却还是违反了。一周没有零花钱，也没有电视。我通常不会这么做的，但这次我必须站出来。

english: What? For being a couple of hours late, you have to be kidding.
chinese: 你才迟到几个小时，就开玩笑说要请假/休息一天？

english: I don't want to hear it. Now go to your room.
chinese: 我不想去听。现在去你的房间。

english: All right, we're back. So a very typical case somebody or the kid returns home. It's too late and now they're in trouble.
chinese: 好的，我们回来了。这种情况非常典型，就是有人或者孩子回家了，已经太晚了，现在他们陷入了困境。

english: Yes, his parents are not very happy in this case. It's his mom who is telling him what the consequences will be.
chinese: 是的，他父母对此并不太高兴。是他妈妈告诉他后果会是什么样的。

english: So let's take a look at language takeaway and find out what some of these keywords are.
chinese: 那么让我们来看看语言 takeaway，看看这些关键词都有些什么。

english: Language takeaway.
chinese: 语言 takeaway。

english: All right, so the first word that we're going to take a look is actually something that his mom said and he said that you are two hours past curfew.
chinese: 好的，我们首先看的这个词其实是他妈妈说的，他说他已经超过了就寝时间两个小时。

english: Curfew. So curfew has to do specifically with the time when your parents expect you at home.
chinese: 宵禁。宵禁主要指的是你父母期望你回家的时间。

english: That's right. So if your curfew is ten o'clock, you have to be home before or by ten o'clock.
chinese: 没错。所以如果你的就寝时间是晚上十点，你必须在晚上十点之前或者正好在晚上十点到家。

english: Right. So in this case, if the boy's curfew is ten o'clock and he arrives home at midnight, 12 o'clock, he's two hours past curfew.
chinese: 好的。所以在这种情况下，如果男孩的宵禁时间是晚上十点，他却在午夜十二点才回到家，那么他就已经晚了两个小时。

english: That's right. And even sometimes cities or governments will implement certain curfews at certain times.
chinese: 没错。甚至有时候城市或政府会在特定时间实施某些宵禁。

english: That's right. And I don't think adults really have curfews at home.
chinese: 说的就是这个。而且我觉得成年人在家其实也没有宵禁的时间。

english: No, I don't think so. It depends on what you want. But kids definitely have curfews.
chinese: 不，我不这么认为。这取决于你想要什么。但孩子们 definitely 有宵禁。

english: What happens though, Marco, when you break curfew?
chinese: Marco，不过你却违反宵禁令了怎么办？

english: So this is a very serious offense and you're going to get punished. And the way that we say this, usually parents to their children, you are grounded or you ground that kid.
chinese: 所以这是非常严重的过错，你要被处罚了。我们通常用这种方式对孩子的父母来说，就是关禁闭或者把那个孩子关禁闭。

english: Okay, so you might have heard this word one talking about airplanes or flights at an airport. The plane was grounded.
chinese: 好的，你可能在谈论飞机或机场航班的时候听说过这个词。飞机被封停了。

english: It basically means it can't go anywhere. And so when you're talking about a kid or a person, you basically mean, okay, you're grounded.
chinese: 这基本上就是意味着它哪儿也去不了。所以当你谈到一个孩子或者一个人时，你基本上就是在说，好吧，你就被‘封门’了。

english: You can't go out with your friends. You can't go anywhere. Usually you can go to school.
chinese: 你不能和朋友们出去。你哪儿都不能去。通常你可以去上学。

english: Right, right. But you can't have fun is the meaning.
chinese: 对，对。但就是不能玩了的意思。

english: That's right. So it's usually a fixed phrase. You're grounded. That means that you are punished. You can't go out.
chinese: 没错。通常是个固定用法。你被扣住了。意思是受到了惩罚，不能出去。

english: But in this case, the mom specifies saying you're grounded. So that means that he can't go out.
chinese: 但在这情况下，妈妈明确说是被禁足了。所以他就不能出去。

english: But on top of that, she said no allowance and no TV for a week.
chinese: 但是她还说这一周没有零用钱，也没有电视。

english: So the mom and so allowance is the money that your parents give you to go out like to go to the movies or something.
chinese: 所以零用钱就是你父母给你去买东西或者看电影之类的费用。

english: And your parents might give this to you on a weekly basis. So every Saturday you get $5 or on a monthly basis every month you get $20.
chinese: 你的父母可能会每周给你。所以你每个周六可以得到5元，或者每月每个月可以得到20元。

english: And when his mother says you're not going to have any allowance for a week, that means we're not going to give you any money this week.
chinese: 而当他妈妈说这一周你没有零用钱的时候，我们就不会给你这周的钱。

english: Right. So that is in allowance. How much money you get per month or per week.
chinese: 明白了。那么是包含在预算之内吗？你每个月或者每周能拿到多少钱？

english: The key thing about allowance though is that it's not something you do for work. You don't work and receive allowance.
chinese: 然而，津贴的关键在于它不是为了工作而做的。你不是为了工作而获得津贴。

english: If you work, you have a salary allowance is something that you get for free from someone.
chinese: 如果你工作，你就有工资福利这种东西是从某人那里免费得到的。

english: Yeah. So you can get an allowance from your boss to eat. But you can also have an allowance from your parents to do fun things.
chinese: 是的。你可以从老板那里得到吃喝的津贴。你也可以从父母那里得到做有趣事情的津贴。

english: That's right. So usually kids obviously they can't work. So they get an allowance from their parents usually for fun things like going to the movies and stuff.
chinese: 没错。所以通常小孩子当然不能工作，他们通常是从父母那里得到零用钱，用于一些娱乐活动，比如去看电影之类的。

english: Exactly. Alright now going back a little bit, let's take a look at two ways that the mom addressed or called her son because obviously it's her son.
chinese: 明白了。现在让我们退后一点，看看妈妈是如何称呼她儿子的，因为显然她是她的儿子。

english: But when he got home she said get in this door young man.
chinese: 但当他回家时她说，年轻人，你进去这个门。

english: Okay, these are angry mom phrases. When you're in trouble your parents tend to use different words to talk to you.
chinese: 好的，这些是愤怒妈妈的用语。当你惹麻烦时，你的父母往往会用不同的词跟你说话。

english: So this is a very popular one young man. Right. So it's like saying you should be mature but you made a mistake.
chinese: 所以這是非常受歡迎的一種說法，年輕人。就是說你應該成熟了但卻犯錯了。

english: Alright so come inside right now young man. Yeah, it's a it's a way to kind of emphasize that you are also very angry.
chinese: 好的，你赶紧进来吧，小伙子。是的，这是一种强调你也非常生气的方式。

english: And also when he was trying to explain what happened she said I don't care. You're grounded for life, Mr.
chinese: 而她却说我不care，先生，你一世都得被禁足。

english: You're grounded for life, Mr. So these are both ways of talking to young boys. Mr. is the opposite of Miss.
chinese: 你这辈子都得待在家里，宋先生。这两种说法都是在和年轻男孩说话的时候用的。宋先生是小姐的反义词。

english: But in the case of a young girl you'd say get in this door young lady. Right. And then you're grounded for life, Missy.
chinese: 但如果是年轻女孩，你得说‘小姐，请进’。对吧。然后你会被禁足一辈子，梅西。

english: Missy? Yeah, I think they say Missy. Missy. So Missy Mr. Young Man young lady. These are always referring to people in kind of it's weird.
chinese: Missy？是的，我觉得他们说Missy。Missy。所以Missy先生小姐女士。这些总是指代一些人，有点奇怪。

english: It's kind of like their adults but they're not. Yeah, that's right. That's like saying you're in trouble. Yeah. So a very interesting thing going on here with this young man who got grounded.
chinese: 这有点像是他们大人的样子，但他们不是。没错，这就像是说你陷入麻烦了。是的。所以这里发生着一件很有趣的事情，就在这位被‘关禁闭’的年轻人身上。

english: Why don't we go back let's take a look at our dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
chinese: 我们为什么不回去看看我们的对话呢，一会儿就回来。

english: Do you know what time it is?
chinese: 你知道现在是什么时间吗？

english: Um, ten.
chinese: 哦，十。

english: Get in this door young man. It's midnight. You are two hours past curfew. I know, but it wasn't my fault. I told Jennifer she had to drop me off before ten. But she wouldn't leave the party.
chinese: 进这门，小伙子。现在是半夜了。你已经超过了就寝时间两个小时。我知道，但那不是我的错。我告诉詹妮弗说她得在十点前送我去。但她就是不肯离开派对。

english: I don't care. You are grounded for life, Mr. Mom. That is so unfair.
chinese: 我不在乎。你一世都得受罚，Mr. 妈妈。那太不公平了。

english: You know the rules and you broke them. No allowance and no TV for a week. I usually never ground you but this time I have to put my foot down.
chinese: 你知道规则，却还是违反了。一周没有零花钱，也没有电视。我通常不会这么做的，但这次我真的要严加管教了。

english: What? For being a couple of hours late, you have to be kidding. I don't want to hear it. Now go to your room.
chinese: 什么？才晚了几小时，你就开这种玩笑了。我不听。快回房间去。

english: All right, we're back. So now let's take a look at four key phrases that we've picked out for you on fluency builder.
chinese: 好的，我们回来了。那么现在让我们来看看流利构建单元中挑选出的四个关键短语。

english: Fluency builder. All right. So this first phrase is something that actually we hear when the young boy or the young man is giving his excuse for being late.
chinese: 流利构建单元。好的。所以这个第一个短语是我们确实会听到年轻男孩或年轻男子迟到的借口中提到的。

english: He said, Listen, I told Jennifer she had to drop me off before ten. That's right. So the phrasal verb there is to drop off.
chinese: 他说，听好了，我告诉詹妮弗她得在十点前送我去。没错，所以那里的短语是下车。

english: This means to leave someone somewhere. That's right. But usually it means to drive someone to a certain place. So for example, Jennifer probably has a car.
chinese: 这意味着将某人留在某个地方。没错，但通常是指开车将某人送到某个地方。所以比如詹妮弗可能有车。

english: And Jennifer was supposed to take this boy home. So he said she was going to drop me off before ten o'clock. That means kind of leave him at his house.
chinese: 而Jennifer原本是打算把他送回家的。所以她说她会在十点之前把我送到他家。这意味着就是让他在自己家里留着。

english: That's right. So the verb is to drop off. But we usually insert the subject in between. So to drop me off. She is going to drop me off.
chinese: 没错。动词是下车。但我们通常会在中间插入主语。所以她是来送我的。

english: I dropped him off at the bank. That's right. All right. So now that Jennifer was supposed to drop him off at ten. That didn't happen. So he got grounded.
chinese: 我把他在银行接走了。没错。好的。所以现在詹妮弗本来应该十点的时候把他送到的。这没发生。所以他被罚不准出门了。

english: And his mom was saying that she usually doesn't really ground him. But this time I have to put my foot down. She's angry.
chinese: 而他妈妈说她通常不会真的“放纵”他。但这回我必须站出来。“她生气了。”

english: He's upset and she's angry and she said, Listen, I have to put my foot down. What does this mean? You put your foot on the ground. It's strange to hear this phrase.
chinese: 他生气了，她也生气了，她说，听着，我得站稳脚跟。这句什么意思？听这种说法很奇怪。

english: It means that she's going to be strict. That she's not going to let him just get away with it or not ground him. She really has to be strict and she has to punish him.
chinese: 这意味着她会很严格。不会让他就这么轻易地逃避或者不罚他。她必须非常严格，必须惩罚他。

english: Okay. So to put your foot down or I put my foot down, this means to be strict with someone to not maybe bend the rules or be flexible.
chinese: 好吧。所以“放狠话”或者我说“我放狠话”，意思是严格要求某人，不让其可能违反规则或变得灵活。

english: So for example, my mother was always very, very loose with my brother. He could do what he wanted or whatever. But one day he did something really horrible and she finally put her foot down.
chinese: 所以比如，我妈妈一直以来对我的弟弟都非常宽松。他可以随心所欲做任何事。但有一天他做了件非常可怕的事情，她终于坚持了下来。

english: And she grounded him. She grounded him for three months.
chinese: 她把他 grounding 了，grounding 了三个月。

english: All right. So that's what happens when somebody puts their foot down. And now obviously he was very surprised that he's going to be grounded for so long.
chinese: 好的。这就是有人把脚跺下的结果。现在他显然非常惊讶自己要被禁足这么长时间。

english: And only for being a couple of hours late. So he said, you have to be kidding. You have got to be kidding. So this is a rhetorical. So he's not talking about joking here.
chinese: 而且仅仅因为晚了几个小时。所以他说道，你在开玩笑吧。你在开玩笑吧。所以这是在 rhetorical 的话术里。所以他这里并不是在开玩笑。

english: He's saying, no way. I can't believe it. This is not happening to me. Yeah, you're not serious. You're not serious. So he's upset. And I would be too. No one likes to be grounded.
chinese: 他说，绝不可能。我真不敢相信。这不该发生在我的身上。嗯，你一点都不认真。你一点也不认真。所以他很生气。我也一样。没有人喜欢被禁足。

english: But he's saying, okay, come on. No way. That's too serious. That's right. So this is what this is a phrase that you can use with someone if you're not really believing what they're saying or you're surprised. You have to be kidding me.
chinese: 但他说，行啊。不行。太严重了。对吧。所以这就是你说的那句话，如果你不怎么相信他们说的话或者你感到惊讶的时候可以用。你是在开玩笑吗？

english: Yeah, but usually there's also a degree of anger. So you're upset at the decision. For example, I'm watching the the world cup right now. And there was a foul. And I was very upset because I didn't think it was a foul. And I said, you have got to be kidding me.
chinese: 是的，但通常也有几分愤怒。所以你会对这个决定感到不满。比如我现在正在看世界杯比赛。发生了一次犯规行为。我非常生气，因为我认为那不算犯规。我说，你这是在开玩笑吧。

english: That's right. Okay. So that's exactly the way that we would use that phrase. And well, obviously the mother had made up her mind. She's very decided. And she said, I don't want to hear it.
chinese: 没错。好。所以我们就是用这句话的方式。当然，妈妈已经做出了决定。她非常坚决。她说，我不想听。

english: So this is the end of the conversation. Okay. This is one of those phrases that will just stop anything you're talking about. So they're arguing and she says, nope, I don't want to hear it. That means no more excuses. No more talking. This is the end.
chinese: 那么这就是对话的结束。好。这是那种一说完就堵住你所有话题的话。他们还在争论，她就说，不，我不想听了。意思是不要再找借口了。不要再说话了。这就结束了。

english: That's right. I don't want to hear it. And it's using many scenarios, right? Not only for somebody being angry or grounded, but also in a meeting. I don't want to hear it. That's it. We're doing my idea. We're going forward with it.
chinese: 这就是了。我不想再听了。而且它用了很多场景，对吧？不仅有人生气或者被隔离的时候用，还在会议上也用。我不想再听了。就是这样。我们按照我的想法去做。继续前进。

english: Well, be careful because that's usually what the boss will say. That's right. It's not it's not the most gentle phrase. And so you have to be careful with how you use it. But if you have authority like your apparent or your boss, you can say, nope, I don't want to hear it. I have made my decision.
chinese: 小心，老板通常会这么说。没错，这不是最温柔的措辞。所以你得小心使用它。但如果你有那样的权力，比如你的主管，你可以这样说：不，我不想听。我已经做出了决定。

english: That's right. Okay. So we've taken a look at a lot of great things. Why don't we go back, listen to our dialogue one last time. And we'll be back in a bit.
chinese: 那就是这样。好的。我们已经看了很多很棒的东西。要不要再回来看看，听一遍我们的对话？一会儿就回来。

english: Do you know what time it is?
chinese: 你知道现在是什么时间吗？

english: Get in this door young man. It's midnight. You are two hours past curfew.
chinese: 进来吧，小伙子。现在已经 midnight 了，你已经超过了熄灯时间两个小时。

english: I know, but it wasn't my fault. I told Jennifer she had to drop me off before 10, but she wouldn't leave the party.
chinese: 我知道，但不是我的错。我告诉詹妮弗10点前要把我送到，但她却不愿意离开派对。

english: I don't care. You are grounded for life, Mr. Mom, that is so unfair. You know the rules and you broke them. No allowance and no TV for a week. I usually never ground you, but this time I have to put my foot down.
chinese: 我不care。你被禁足一辈子了，Mr. 妈妈，这太不公平了。你知道规则，却违反了它们。一周没有零花钱和电视。我通常不会这么做的，但这次我必须站出来。

english: What? For being a couple of hours late, you have to be kidding. I don't want to hear it. Now go to your room.
chinese: 什么？才晚了几小时，你就骗人呢。我不听。去你的房间。

english: Alright, we're back. So obviously we've all been grounded. What is the longest you've been grounded for? Do you remember?
chinese: 好的，我们回来了。那么显然我们都被禁飞了。你最长被禁飞多少天？还记得吗？

english: I was a good girl, so maybe a week. Really? Maybe not even. I never really gotten trouble as a kid. What about you?
chinese: 我乖乖的，也许也就一周吧。真的？可能连一个星期都不到。小时候我也没怎么惹过事啊。你呢？

english: I think once I was grounded the entire summer vacation. I don't remember exactly what I did, but my dad was pretty upset with me. He was really strict, so I got grounded quite a bit.
chinese: 我想那一次整个暑假都被爸爸“管教”了。具体做了什么我记不太清楚，但我知道爸爸对我挺生气的，他很严格，所以我被‘管教’的时间也比较多。

english: I tend to think that girls get in trouble less. I don't know if it's because they're good. I think probably it's because they're better at hiding things from their parents.
chinese: 我觉得女孩子犯错的几率较小。我不确定是因为她们好，可能是因为她们更擅长从父母那里藏匿事情。

english: Yeah, maybe. Because whenever I would come home, my mother would always wake up, but she doesn't really understand what time it is.
chinese: 嗯，也许吧。因为我每次回家，妈妈总是会醒来，但她其实并不真正明白现在是几点。

english: So I'd say, oh, Mom, it's 11 o'clock. Good night. It'd be like four o'clock in the morning and she had no idea.
chinese: 所以我说，妈，都快11点了。晚安。凌晨四点的时候她还不知道。

english: So who was the person or the parent that put their foot down? Was it your mom or your dad?
chinese: 那么是谁或者谁是你的父母，让他们最终妥协了呢？是妈妈还是爸爸？

english: It's my dad. What's the serious one? Oh, really? Yeah, it's interesting because sometimes it's the dad that's very strict and the mom kind of helps you out and tries to kind of not get you grounded or something.
chinese: 这是我爸。哪一种比较严重呢？哦，真的吗？是的，挺有意思的，有时候是爸爸很严格，妈妈会帮你一把，试图尽量不让你被‘关禁闭’之类的。

english: But sometimes it's the other way around. The mom is really strict and firm and the dad's like, come on, don't ground him.
chinese: 但有时候则是另一回事。妈妈非常严格和坚定，爸爸则说，别把他禁足了。

english: They're just having fun. Well, I think in some families, the children understand who is strict and who is maybe not so strict.
chinese: 他们只是在玩乐。嗯，在某些家庭里，孩子们能理解谁是严格的，谁可能不算严格。

english: And so they say, oh, well, Mom said that it's okay. So I think maybe you should let me go out and the dad will be very angry because the mother said that it's okay.
chinese: 所以有人说，哦，妈妈说可以嘛。所以我以为你应该让我出去，爸爸会非常生气因为妈妈说可以了。

english: That's right. All right. So that's all the time we have for today. We're really curious to get your stories. Maybe tell us why were you grounded or how long were you grounded for?
chinese: 没错。好的。今天我们就到这里了。我们真的很想知道你的故事。或许你可以告诉我们你为什么被禁足，以及你是被禁足了多少天？

english: Or what was your curfew when you were a child or growing up? Our website is engluchpa.com. We hope to see you there.
chinese: 你小时候或成长过程中有宵禁时间吗？我们的网站是engluchpa.com。期待你的光临。

english: All right. We'll see you guys there. Bye.
chinese: 好的。到时候见。拜拜。

english: Thank you.
chinese: 谢谢。
